findings.claim: The inquiry covers a 25-supermarket trial from 2024-02-08 through 2024-09-07.
findings.qualification: May 2025 report edition differs from 2025-06-04 publication. The specific safeguarded trial conclusion is not blanket approval of all deployments.

findings.claim: The report estimates up to 13 verification failures, comprising nine misidentifications and four other procedural failures.
findings.qualification: Reported estimate with nine plus four categories, not a hard upper bound on all failures, thirteen confirmed independent events or a uniform harm measure. Paragraph 221 notes incomplete records and possible additional failures.

findings.claim: The summary reports approximately 226 million scans including repeats.
findings.qualification: Scans are not unique people, distinct exposures or injuries.
